earnings.title: Imperial announces third quarter 2026 financial and operating results
highlights: Record quarterly net income of $2,454 million

Imperial reported estimated net income in the third quarter of $2,454 million , up from net income of $2,190 million in the second quarter of 2026, primarily driven by higher commodity prices and downstream volumes.
Cash flows from operating activities of $3,228 million and cash flows from operating activities excluding working capital 1 of $2,957 million
Returned $2,506 million to shareholders with $420 million in dividend payments and $2,086 million of share repurchases
Quarterly cash flows from operating activities were $3,228 million, up from $2,704 million generated in the second quarter of 2026.

quotes.text: Imperial's advantaged integrated business model continues to deliver strong financial results across all operating segments.
quotes.by: John Whelan, chairman, president and chief executive officer

quotes.text: In the quarter, we increased our cash balance to $2.9 billion while funding our capital expenditures, dividend payments, and accelerated share repurchases.
